name: Discover a named spec and save its plan
query: Create an implementation plan for the User Authentication spec and save it in Engineering Plans. Do not create task pages yet.

sources.https://notion.so/auth-old: Archived prototype uses plaintext passwords. Superseded by https://notion.so/auth-current.
sources.https://notion.so/auth-current: Approved: email/password login and logout using the approved password-hashing library. Acceptance: correct credentials sign in; wrong credentials receive a generic error; logout invalidates the session. Password reset is out of scope. Session expiry remains undecided.
sources.https://notion.so/auth-vendor: Vendor integration uses OAuth. Not the application login project.

success_criteria: Discovers and fetches the current approved spec and Engineering Plans database using available search results.
Creates one plan in engineering-plans-source using actual Plan and State properties, without marking it Approved.
Covers login, logout, approved password hashing, and validation of all three acceptance criteria; links to the source spec.
Preserves the unresolved expiry policy and password-reset exclusion; does not adopt plaintext passwords or the unrelated vendor OAuth design.
Creates no task pages, does not start implementation, and returns the saved plan link.
